notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (Cloudflare-managed) disallows ClaudeBot/GPTBot/CCBot/etc full-site but Allow: / for User-agent: * (search=yes, ai-train=no) - tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome would be blocked by the named ClaudeBot disallow, but tier (a) direct HTTP fetch is not named and was used exclusively; no browser needed. Shopify storefront (Merox-based theme), all pages fetched via requests with a browser UA, no blocks encountered. TREE: built from union of (1) rendered desktop mega-menu (8 top-level items: New Arrivals, Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Lighting, Wall Decor, Bath Decor, Furniture, Discover - only Decor and Kitchen & Dining have text-link mega-menu columns; Wall Decor/Bath Decor/Furniture/Discover use image-push menus with no additional text subcategories) and (2) the full XML product-sitemap collections list (636 collection URLs, mostly price-tier/sale/seasonal/curated marketing collections which were excluded per View-All/Collections/Promotional rule). Cross-referenced every collection handle containing textile or storage keywords (cushion, curtain, blanket, rug, towel, table-runner, placemat, tapestry, napkin, laundry, storage, organiser, shelf, rack, basket, box, hook, drawer, cabinet, trolley, cart) against actual rendered product listings (product handles + H1) to confirm primary product type per collection, since many site collection names are misleading (e.g. 'Wall Shelves' collection actually contains storage racks/cabinets, not decorative shelves; 'Shelving' collection contains one purely decorative cast-iron item and was excluded; 'Tables + Storage' is a Furniture-menu collection mixing console/center tables with a few storage pieces and was left to the Furniture task per storage.md Sec.21). QTY: exact site-rendered '<n> products' text from the <span class="product-facet__meta-bar-item--count"> element on each collection page (server-rendered, present in raw HTML, no JS needed); this text already excludes the site's own 'The Decor Kart Gift Card' product that appears padded into every collection's product list. Two collections (Storage Basket, Laundry Bags under Storage; Tapestry Art under Textile) render an explicit 'Empty collection - This collection does not contain any products.' state, so qty=0 was recorded per storage.md Sec.39 zero-product-category rule (applied consistently to Textile too). EXCLUDED and why: napkin-rings (ring/holder accessory, not the cloth napkin itself - Kitchen & Dining/decor, not Textile); tapestry-art/rack-display/storage-basket/laundry-bags are zero-product but storage-basket/laundry-bags/tapestry-art were still recorded per the zero-product rule, rack-display was dropped because its name and site placement (rack/display) signal decorative display racks, not storage, per storage.md Sec.19; wall-hooks (single product, decorative bird-shaped wall hooks - Wall Decor, not genuine storage hardware); shelving (single product, explicitly named 'decorative shelf set', cast-iron ornamental - Wall Decor/Decorative boundary, storage.md Sec.18); tables-storage (Furniture-menu 'Tables + Storage' collection, 57 products dominated by console/center tables and bar carts - primary category context is Furniture per storage.md Sec.21, left for the Furniture task); minimalist-organiser (8-product themed/curated marketing collection mixing drinkware, decorative trays, furniture and one storage rack - not a genuine navigational subcategory, excluded as a curated/promotional collection); vanity-trays (decorative acrylic serving trays and bathroom sets - Decorative/Bath boundary, not storage per storage.md Sec.24); storage-canisters-sale and decorative-storage-sale (duplicate '-sale' filtered versions of already-captured collections, excluded as promotional per storage.md Sec.35); shelf-styling-made-easy (curated styling-tips marketing collection, excluded as promotional); bar-carts and the-cocktail-cart (serving/bar furniture, not storage, storage.md Sec.20); mystery-box, musical-box, tissue-boxes, bread-boxes, cartoon-mugs, rooster-egg-baskets (false-positive keyword matches on 'box'/'basket' - not storage products). Cushions collection (fabric cushion covers, confirmed via product handles) sits under the site's own 'Decor > Storage & Organisation' mega-menu column but was reclassified into Textile per textile.md Sec.4/22 (primary product type is fabric cushion cover, not a storage item) and textile.md's core classification principle overriding website column placement; it is recorded as a standalone Textile leaf rather than force-nested under a Storage-named group. No duplicate rows: every sub-category has a unique canonical /collections/<handle> URL, none reused across two rows.
